scope: Real pinned RustFS, 24 three-voter groups, archived-prefix file reclamation, retained-disk restart and bounded store outage. All latency/throughput observations are host-contended; no Q1 or sustainable-capacity claim.
baseline_instrumentation_note: Baseline production Rust is unchanged; the eleven common files were copied into the detached baseline checkout. Its raw working_tree_dirty flag is true.
performance_qualification: Contended observations only. Active unrelated host rustc processes were observed at run boundaries for every healthy sustained run. Boundary samples are not continuous host-utilization measurements. No causal latency, sustainable capacity or default-tuning conclusion.

checks.python_skip_reason: Existing opt-in Docker build-fixture regression; CELLAR_PERF_DOCKER_TEST was not set. Both actual benchmark images were separately built and source/executable verified.
checks.native_dependency_check: passed; 466 reachable packages; no JavaScript engine

setup_attempts: Initial guest Docker pull failed on DNS; temporary guest resolver correction enabled builds and was restored before workloads.
Two initial candidate build attempts found missing RPC workspace tool inputs; full tools COPY fixed the recipe. Successful candidate/baseline builds used the identical corrected recipe.
Two baseline smoke preflight attempts aborted on TCP TIME_WAIT before workload creation; no listener was present. Private driver enabled SO_REUSEADDR and retries passed.
cleanup: All owned node/store processes stopped with exit zero and no OOM. Data volumes and stopped containers retained. Only exact owned empty networks removed; no global prune.

profile.qualification: Local same-VM archived-log reclamation experiment; not production capacity or independent failure-domain qualification.

post_shutdown_volume_sizes.scope: Read-only apparent directory bytes after clean shutdown; includes directory entries; separate from live retained-file censuses.

fault_result.scope: Bounded RustFS process pauses; fresh serialized commands observed in each window. Final adapter state checks bound recovery. No crash, packet-loss, Amazon S3, causal latency or equivalent-contract claim.

recovery.scope: Original outcomes remain ambiguous in measurement. Each original identity is resolved and confirmed after workload completion; its prior commit time is unknown.

outage_checkpoint_observations.scope: Read-only per-replica admin observations strictly enclosed by a physically observed RustFS pause; not atomic across replicas.
